messages.subject: Melbourne Sealtech - Defence served
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Gallagher,

Please find served herewith our client's Defence in Claim No. HT-2025-000318. Our client admits supply of the seals but denies breach, denies causation (relying on misapplication and mis-installation), and relies on clauses 11 and 12 to exclude the loss of profit and cap liability at £398,040.

Kind regards,
Rowan Chase
Associate, Denham Lewis LLP

messages.plaintextBody:
Defence in. No surprises - the whole case turns on (a) expert on breach/causation and (b) whether the cap and the consequential-loss exclusion bite on the Pennland profit claim. We should get Okonjo's written advice on the cap before the CMC.

Tom

Tom Gallagher
Associate
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
